notes:
Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter and Zaiqa Kitchen apps, version 2.13.45.

Floating Z bubble when minimized + printer on/off controls
- When you minimize the POS (to take a call etc.) a small draggable "Z" bubble stays on screen. Green = POS running, red = POS page stopped answering. Tap it to open the POS. Needs "Display over other apps".
- New print controls in Settings > General > Printing: cancelled-item slip, waiter bills, waiter customer copy (due), shift report (Z) - each can be turned on or off, alongside KOT, delivery bill, cash drawer and auto bill
- Manual reprints always print
